ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominance across approximately 80% of the visible surface with low-intensity black borders.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous zones across both lobes; dark low-intensity pixels defining the periphery and trailing edge; two distinct high-contrast yellowish-brown geometric blobs originating from the peduncle and radiating into the lower central lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a high bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 5-15 pixels, appearing most jagged on the left lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex trailing edge trajectory terminating in sharp, tapered distal tips with a slight upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small dark circular pixel clusters on the mid-surface of the left lobe; high-contrast white clustering on the far left distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned vertical and diagonal dark linear disruptions on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive symmetrical yellowish-brown pigmentation concentrated at the base of the fluke, characteristic of biological staining.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant jagged irregularities and apparent tissue loss along the left trailing edge margin creating a highly unique structural profile.
